sql_templates.description: Retrieve the latest sector breadth and stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM breadth.sector_daily),
latest_stage AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
SELECT sd.sector, sd.pct_above_50dma, ma.stage2_pct, ss.trading_signal
FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON sd.snapshot_date = ls.snapshot_date
JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON sd.sector = ss.sector AND ss.snapshot_date = latest_stage.snapshot_date
WHERE ss.stage = 'STAGE_2' AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY sd.pct_above_50dma DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: Summarize only validated evidence, surface missing evidence, and keep research-only framing.

validation_rules: required_tables_exist
sql_is_read_only
